boundary: Platform specifications are public inputs, while tap layout, switching loss, group index, interlayer couplers, GDS/DRC, timing jitter, and fabrication remain unverified engineering work.

frequency_bin_option.verdict: Promising serialization alternative, but the complete multi-tone translator/filter loss and crosstalk network is not yet certified.

revised_architecture: Use a foundry-qualified low-loss tapped delay-line bank as the first physical storage candidate; reserve resonators for spectrally narrowed pulses and frequency-bin buffering for a later active conversion design.

single_pole_resonator.verdict: A passive single-pole high-Q resonator cannot simultaneously accept an unreshaped 5 ps transform-limited pulse and retain it for 40 ps below 1 dB; high Q solves lifetime but destroys bandwidth.
